name: iPhone Duo-inspired foldable promotion skills
description: Attribution-preserving reference source plus 10 promotion rules and one editable Cupric Studio foldable-device action. Apple reference assets are excluded.
license: MIT for original application code; Apple model, textures, wallpapers, screenshots and trademarks retain their owners' rights.

items.name: Keep the rear-camera half fixed
items.description: For a foldable product reveal, keep the camera-side panel stable and rotate only the cover panel around a clear hinge. This gives the audience a readable anchor while the product opens.

data.instruction: For a foldable product reveal, keep the camera-side panel stable and rotate only the cover panel around a clear hinge. This gives the audience a readable anchor while the product opens.

items.name: Project screen content from the front view
items.description: Keep the browser, SaaS dashboard, product page or campaign artwork aligned to one front-view coordinate system while the device folds. Reproject the outer panel instead of stretching the UI with the mesh.

data.instruction: Keep the browser, SaaS dashboard, product page or campaign artwork aligned to one front-view coordinate system while the device folds. Reproject the outer panel instead of stretching the UI with the mesh.

items.name: Use progressive edge treatment
items.description: As a panel recedes, progressively reduce visible coverage and add deterministic blur or darkening toward its folded edge. Keep the effect bounded so copy and product details remain legible.

data.instruction: As a panel recedes, progressively reduce visible coverage and add deterministic blur or darkening toward its folded edge. Keep the effect bounded so copy and product details remain legible.

items.name: Plan screen modes
items.description: Offer intentional modes for wallpaper, launcher, custom media, browser flow, SaaS dashboard, product page and social proof. Use real user copy and media; never invent reviews or metrics.

data.instruction: Offer intentional modes for wallpaper, launcher, custom media, browser flow, SaaS dashboard, product page and social proof. Use real user copy and media; never invent reviews or metrics.

items.name: Give the fold a beat
items.description: Use a deliberate closed hold, open reveal, readable hold, and optional return or peek. Land the logo, feature, browser result or CTA on the stable open state rather than during the hinge blur.

data.instruction: Use a deliberate closed hold, open reveal, readable hold, and optional return or peek. Land the logo, feature, browser result or CTA on the stable open state rather than during the hinge blur.

items.name: Use the duo as a promotion stage
items.description: For a SaaS launch: closed device hook → hinge opens → browser or app flow plays on the inner screens → outer panel carries the concise CTA → finish on a clean product lockup. Keep all stages editable.

data.instruction: For a SaaS launch: closed device hook → hinge opens → browser or app flow plays on the inner screens → outer panel carries the concise CTA → finish on a clean product lockup. Keep all stages editable.

items.name: Make media replaceable
items.description: Let users replace wallpaper, screenshot, browser capture, product image or UI copy without rebuilding geometry. Keep screen projection, crop, safe areas and fold timing independent from content.

data.instruction: Let users replace wallpaper, screenshot, browser capture, product image or UI copy without rebuilding geometry. Keep screen projection, crop, safe areas and fold timing independent from content.

items.name: Separate orbit from fold controls
items.description: A 3D product view may orbit or zoom, but its timeline fold control must remain deterministic and independently editable. Preview controls must not become wall-clock animation in export.

data.instruction: A 3D product view may orbit or zoom, but its timeline fold control must remain deterministic and independently editable. Preview controls must not become wall-clock animation in export.

items.name: Respect reference assets
items.description: Use the motion idea and implementation pattern without bundling Apple reference models or screenshots. Link to original sources and disclose trademarks and asset restrictions.

data.instruction: Use the motion idea and implementation pattern without bundling Apple reference models or screenshots. Link to original sources and disclose trademarks and asset restrictions.

items.name: Translate into the host renderer
items.description: When the target is Cupric Studio, implement the fold as a native deterministic scene that shares the preview/export renderer. Do not execute the upstream webpage or require a remote Three.js asset at render time.

data.instruction: When the target is Cupric Studio, implement the fold as a native deterministic scene that shares the preview/export renderer. Do not execute the upstream webpage or require a remote Three.js asset at render time.

items.name: Duo foldable promotion stage
items.description: Apply an editable two-panel foldable device to a selected image, video or recorded UI component. Browser flows, SaaS launches, product pages, social posts and custom media stay replaceable.
